items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: That's how I got close to Snooky. That's how I was able to bring Ben Webster in town. Because they just gave me the deal to booking the place.

ctx.x: Yeah. Dizzy was a good comedian, so... I got involved with that a little bit when Snooky was on 45th Street or 44th Street, and that's how I got close to Dizzy. Because I got him the job down there... Because I was having trouble with Morris Levy. Morris Levy didn't want to pay him more... We was trying to make another fifty dollars. We was only making twelve-hundred dollars; we was trying to get $1250 -- and he just didn't want to pay us no more money. So I went and got him a job for $1500 at Snooky's. And he…

So I went over one night to Birdland, and Morris said, "What's Dizzy doing?" I said, "He's playing over at Snooky's." And it just so happened that the guys at Snooky's was supposed to give us another deal, but they was kind of reneging on the deal. You know, they didn't want...
